subject: Peak window credit endorsement request — weekend throughput validation
messages:
From: Emma Sullivan <emma@dataswift.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: short-term credits for weekend peak-window throughput validation

Hi Aisha,

Quick one — our infra team at DataSwift is running a weekend throughput validation to qualify Redwood for an internal migration. The test is scheduled for the weekend of May 21–23 and will include sustained ~4k rps traffic windows (3x typical) and latency p95 targets.

We'd like to request a short-term promotional voucher/credit to cover the run: ~72 hours of elevated traffic, estimated at 450k tokens total. This is a POC validation; if it looks good we move forward with Dedicated capacity. Can you let me know what you can provision and the approval path?

Attached: dataswift_sim_plan.csv (traffic profile, sequences)

Thanks,
Emma Sullivan
Director, ML Ops — DataSwift
emma@dataswift.com
Attachment: dataswift_sim_plan.csv (text/csv)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma@dataswift.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: short-term credits for weekend peak-window throughput validation

Hi Emma — thanks for the details and the sim plan. We can usually support weekend peak windows with a short-term credit voucher but need to confirm a couple things internally:

- Exact token estimate and associated cost bucket (you listed 450k tokens; we'll map to promo allowance).
- Any additional SLA needs (regional routing, burst windows).
- Whether logs/telemetry from the run will be visible to your team or we keep a limited retention for the promo run.

I looped in Marissa (Sales Ops) and Karthik (SRE/SE) to review policy and technical constraints. Marissa — can you weigh in on what promotional credit size we can approve and any contractual notes (promo terms)? Karthik — can you confirm whether we need to pin a model/quantization profile to prevent unexpected token usage?

Emma — we'll get back with an answer by EOD Friday, May 14.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Aisha_Redwood@redwood.com

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:52:00 -0400
Subject: Internal: endorsement request — DataSwift weekend run (DSW-4721)

Marissa / Karthik,

Forwarding DataSwift's sim plan. Key ask: 72-hour elevated window (~450k tokens) for throughput validation on hosted API. They will exercise streaming + short prompt chains; latency is primary.

Why we should approve: high-propensity account, clear path to Dedicated; run is time-boxed and non-recurring if they opt in.

Risks / constraints to capture:
- Limit promo to specific model variant (e.g., redwood-7b-quant) to cap cost.
- Restrict run to us-west region and set token caps per minute.
- Require telemetry access and a short post-run debrief.

Attaching the sim plan. If we can approve up to $5k equivalent in credits under promo policy that should cover the run. Please advise on the final amount and preferred approval wording so I can confirm with the customer.

Thanks,
Aisha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Internal: endorsement request — DataSwift weekend run (DSW-4721)

Aisha,

I reviewed the sim details and approve a promotional credit endorsement with conditions. Summary:

- Approved amount: up to $4,200 (internal promo cap for outbound POCs where Dedicated is likely).
- Conditions: credit restricted to redwood-7b-quant and us-west only; token throttles set to 10k tokens/min sustained; run must be limited to the 72-hour window and auto-disabled thereafter.
- Compliance: Data retention limited to 7 days for this run; customer must sign the promo terms doc.

I've attached the standard promotional_terms.pdf with the sign-off language. Please add this to the doc you send Emma and confirm they sign before the run. Karthik — please confirm that the SE team can pin the model and set the throttles by next week; we need a short operational playbook for the weekend.

Marissa Cole
Head, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: promotional_terms.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma@dataswift.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: short-term credits for weekend peak-window throughput validation

Emma — good news. We can support the May 21–23 throughput validation with a limited promotional voucher. Details below: 

- Voucher: $4,200 credit applied to account DSW-4721; valid only for the run window.
- Technical constraints: redwood-7b-quant model, us-west region; token throttle set to 10k tokens/min sustained; run will be disabled at 2027-05-24 00:00 UTC.
- Compliance: logs retained for 7 days post-run; DataSwift must return signed promo_terms (attached link).

Next steps:
1) Please review and e-sign the promo terms: https://redwood.app/promo/DSW-4721/terms
2) Confirm exact start UTC for the run (we suggest 2027-05-21T00:00:00Z).
3) Karthik will reach out Monday to coordinate the pinning/throttle playbook.

Attachment: credit-cost-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — happy to help get the run green-lit.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
